details.biography:
Jacob's Well · Seat 2, Healer

You are an aasimar priestess of Lathander, dark-skinned, and you blaze with dawn light when you pray. Patient, sunny and quietly stubborn, you believe every bad night ends in a morning, and a snowstorm is only a long night. You joined the Keepers because the frontier needed a healer who would walk into the dark with them, not wait at the gate.

Tonight: Someone upstairs is very ill. Nobody will let you see him.

In a fight

Open with Bless, then keep everyone standing with Cure Light Wounds. Spiritual Weapon on anything the front line can't reach, Hold Person on a dangerous humanoid. If the dead walk, Turn Undead and bring the hammer down.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Cleric list. See the spell page.

Turn Undead. 6 times a day, as an action: undead within 30ft that can see or hear you make a Will save (DC 14) or flee and stay beyond 30ft for 1 minute.

Perfect Recall. Once a day, recall a 1st-level spell you've already cast with a Wisdom check (DC 10) and cast it again without spending a slot.

Steadfast Faith (2nd). Advantage on saves against the abilities of undead: drains, paralysis, fear and possession.

Lathander's Favour. Your first hit each round on undead deals +1d6 radiant damage, and it can't regain HP until the end of its next turn. Once a day: a 20ft burst of dawn light; undead in it make a Will save (DC 14) or flee for 1 minute. Favoured weapon: heavy mace.

Healer (feat, 1st). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die. Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot.

Aasimar. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to necrotic and radiant. Advantage on saves against being Frightened. Shed bright light in a 10ft radius at will. Advantage on Singing checks (chosen skill). Celestial Wings: you glide, take no damage from falls, and move 2ft sideways for every 1ft you drop. From 3rd level you fly at your walking speed, but not in medium or heavy armour, so not in your mail. You fall if knocked Prone, Stunned, Paralysed or Unconscious in the air.

Casting

Cure Light Wounds heals 1d8+4 with Healer. Other good picks tonight: Sanctuary, Shield of Faith (1st); Aid (not with Bless), Lesser Restoration, Silence (2nd).

Armour Class on the sheet: Scale mail +4, steel shield +1

Divine FavourA flagrant breach of your god's tenets Strains their favour; a second, or abandoning your god, makes you Forsaken. A Forsaken Cleric loses Spell Use (cantrips included), Turn Undead and everything built on it, Steadfast Faith, Divine Monolith and the deity's granted power until they atone. They keep their Hit Points, Base to Hit, weapon and armour training, and a Battle Priest's Extra Attack (see Divine Favour in Book II).
IdentityA priest whose god answers in spells: healer, warder and scourge of the undead, and in war a battle priest in mail.

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As an action, up to 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day, present your holy symbol: every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you makes a Will save against your Class Save DC. Turning is not fear: nothing that prevents, ends or gives Advantage against fear, Frightened or Terrified protects a creature from being Turned or ends it.
  • Below 8th level: a failed save means it is Turned for 1 minute (see Conditions in The Arneyan Codex). The turning ends early for an undead you attack or cast a harmful spell at; Turning Radiance, and spells of yours already in place, do not end it.
  • 6th level (Turning Radiance): undead that fail also take radiant damage equal to your Cleric level.
  • 8th level: a failed save destroys the undead outright if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level; otherwise it is Turned.
  • 10th level: your Turn Undead reaches 60ft, and a Turned undead can't regain HP until the turning ends.
  • Deity's favour: once a day, you may spend two uses of Turn Undead to use your deity's daily power one more time.
  • Evil Clerics: an Evil Cleric may turn or control undead under the same DC.
  • Controlling works on an undead whose Level is no more than half your Cleric level (Level ½ or lower at 1st).
  • Controlled undead obey for 1 hour per Cleric level, and count against the same limit as undead you raise: twice your Cleric level in Hit Dice in all.

Weapon Selection

  • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without Disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list. Your deity's favoured weapon also serves as your holy symbol.

Battle Priest

  • Effect: An option you may take.
    • If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
    • The choice is permanent.
    • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +12 at 20th) instead of the Cleric's, you are trained with every melee weapon, and you gain Extra Attack at 7th level.
    • Your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level, never lower than the 1st-level row, and you never gain slots above 7th level.
    • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.

2nd Level

Steadfast Faith

  • Effect: You have Advantage on saves against the abilities of undead (drains, paralysis, fear and possession). Always on.

3rd Level

Perfect Recall

  • Effect: Once per day, cast a spell you have already cast today without expending a slot: a 1st-level spell, or of 2nd level or lower from 9th level, and 4th or lower from 15th.

4th Level

Cleansing Prayer

  • Effect: When a spell you cast or your deity's granted power restores HP to a creature, it also ends Poisoned or Frightened on that creature (Sickened and Terrified included).

5th Level

Banish

  • Effect: Your Turn Undead also works on fiends and other extraplanar creatures (those the Banishment spell names), but they save with Advantage.
  • One that fails is Turned.
  • From 8th level, one that fails and whose Level is no more than half your Cleric level is instead driven back to its home plane and cannot return by its own power for 24 hours; on its home plane it is Turned.
  • 15th level: they no longer save with Advantage.

7th Level

Extra Attack (Battle Priest only)

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

9th Level

Divine Monolith

  • Effect: A 10ft aura of divine power, on whenever you are conscious, that cannot be dispelled.
  • You and your allies within it have Advantage on Will saves; if your deity already gives you Advantage on a save the aura covers, your aura reaches 10ft further instead.
  • Undead anywhere in your Turn Undead's reach have Disadvantage on their saves against it.
  • 15th level: the aura grows to 20ft. You and your allies within it are immune to instant-death effects, as Death Ward, and have Advantage on all saves, not Will saves only.

10th Level

Answered Prayer

  • Effect: Once per encounter, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that heals or protects one creature, it also affects a second creature in range, at no extra slot.

Renown: Name

  • Effect: Your deeds are known. Title: Reverend, or your faith's own title. Temples of your faith shelter you and your party, and cast their spells for you at half price. Your first follower, an acolyte, joins you.

13th Level

Divine Counsel

  • Effect: Once a day, ask your god one yes-or-no question about what the next day holds, as Augury, without a slot.

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).
  • Renown: Holding: you may found a shrine as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms).
  • Banish, Perfect Recall and Divine Monolith improve, as their entries say.

17th Level

Voice of the Faith

  • Effect: Temples and the faithful of your god give you shelter, healing at cost and a hearing. You can claim sanctuary for yourself and your companions.

20th Level

Divine Intervention

  • Effect: Once a week, as your action, call on your god.
  • Your god answers with any one Cleric spell of your choice, cast at once without a slot or material components, or with a deed beyond any spell, as Miracle's ritual without its offerings or Exhaustion.
  • Returning the dead still follows Miracle's rule.

Renown: Temple

  • Effect: You may found a temple (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 2d6 faithful and one 1st-level Cleric or Battle Priest join it, and once a year you may muster the Sworn Crusaders (the Holy Order's special unit in Keeps & Kingdoms) without a test. While you hold it, you may cast one spell of 7th level or lower from your list once a week without a slot.

Deities and Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • The Cleric's kit is their deity.
  • Choose one at character creation.
  • Your deity grants a favoured weapon (automatic training even outside the standard list) and a unique granted power, and you follow its tenets (see Divine Favour in Book II).
  • Most deities grant one daily power; a few improve a class feature instead.
  • Your deity is your kit: its granted power reshapes what your faith does.
  • A daily Granted Power that rolls dice for damage or healing gains one more die at 5th, 11th and 17th level, as a cantrip does.
  • Unless its row says otherwise, a Granted Power takes your action. A power that rides a hit or a save takes none.
  • 9th level: you can use your god's once-a-day power twice a day, but only once in an encounter. On the Cleric only Grumbar has no daily power; it improves as its row says.
  • A Cleric of an evil deity (the Evil Deities table, plus Lolth, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet and Tiamat) is an Evil Cleric.
  • Any archdevil or demon lord can be worshipped, but only those in these tables keep Cleric orders.
  • The rest are served by cults and Warlock pacts, unless the GM decides a cult has grown strong enough to train Clerics.

The Tarielian Pantheon

Once per round, when an undead takes a hit from you or fails a save against your spell, it takes +1d6 radiant damage and can't regain HP until the end of its next turn. Once/day, when you use Turn Undead, dawn light fills its area: every enemy in it that is not undead also makes a Will save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.
Chauntea (The Earth's Bloom)SickleTenet: Tend the land, and take no more than it can give back. Advantage on Nature checks. Once/day: cause plants within 20ft to entangle all enemies (Fortitude save or Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns).

Sune (The Full Bloom)WhipTenet: Seek out beauty and create it, and turn ugliness into something fair. Advantage on Persuasion and Performance. Once/day: one creature within 30ft that can see you is Charmed by you for 1 minute (Will save negates; it saves again whenever you or your allies harm it).
Lliira (The Heart of Joy)DartTenet: Find joy and share it, and let no one stifle another's freedom. Advantage on Performance. Once/day, as an action: you and every ally within 30ft end the Frightened condition and gain Advantage on saves against fear and charm for the encounter.
Selûne (The Moonlit Veils)MorningstarTenet: Guide and shelter those lost in darkness. Advantage on Insight checks. Once/day: enter a willing creature's dream during a long rest and communicate freely within it. Once per round, a creature that fails a save against your spell also cannot act out of turn until the end of its next turn. 9th level: in place of a second use, the dream reaches two willing creatures at once, wherever they sleep on this plane.
Tymora (The Fortunate Harvest)Sword, ShortTenet: Take the bold chance, but go in prepared. Advantage on checks in games of chance. Once/day: you or an ally within 30ft rerolls one d20 roll just made and keeps the new result.
Brigh (The Crafted Turn)Hammer, LightTenet: Make something new, and share what you learn. Advantage on Craft and Smith checks. Once/day: repair a broken weapon or armour to full functionality instantly. Once per round, when you cast a spell, you may also temper an ally's weapon or armour by touch: its next hit before your next turn deals +1d6 fire damage, or the next attack against it has Disadvantage.
Torm (The Enduring Duty)GreatswordTenet: Keep your oaths and your loyalty, whatever they cost. Advantage on saves vs fear. Once/day: all allies within 30ft can't be Frightened for the encounter and regain HP equal to your Wisdom modifier.
Helm (The Vigilant End)Sword, BastardTenet: Never abandon a post or a charge you've accepted. +1 AC while using a shield. Once/day: for the encounter, attacks against a touched creature have Disadvantage.
Tyr (The Winter's Justice)Hammer, WarTenet: See justice done, fairly and without favour. Advantage on Persuasion when enforcing a contract or vow. Once/day: compel a creature to honour a stated oath (Will save negates). A creature that knowingly breaks it has Disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. Your first hit each encounter with your war hammer binds the target to the duel: it has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until your next turn.
Ilmater (The Winter's Solace)CestusTenet: Ease the suffering of others, even at cost to yourself. Advantage on First Aid/Healing checks. Once/day: heal a creature for 2d8 + Wisdom modifier HP.

Other Deities

DeityFavoured WeaponTenet and Granted Power
MystraDaggerTenet: Study magic, and respect its danger. Advantage on all Knowledge and Lore checks. Once/day: ask the GM one yes/no question about the current situation and receive a truthful answer (no more than once about the same matter in a day). Once per round, on a hit of yours or when a creature fails a save against your spell, you learn one of its resistances, vulnerabilities or immunities.
SilvanusMaulTenet: Keep the balance of the wild: predator and prey, growth and decay. Advantage on Tracking checks. Once/day: speak with plants and animals for 10 minutes. Once per round, a creature that fails a save against your spell also has its speed halved until its next turn.
AbadarCrossbow, LightTenet: Honour every contract you make. Advantage on checks to appraise, bargain or spot a forgery. Once/day: compel a creature to honour a contract it agreed to (Will save negates). A creature that knowingly breaks it has Disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. 9th level: when you look at a creature, you also know if it has broken a contract in the last 30 days, though not which.
The Raven QueenScytheTenet: Accept death when it comes, your own included. Advantage on saves against instant-death effects. Once/day: touch a willing creature and place it in suspended animation for up to 1 hour: it does not bleed, age, or suffer poison or disease until it ends. Allies within 30ft who fall below 0 HP do not bleed while you are conscious. 9th level: the suspended animation lasts up to a day.
Drake (Drakaenar)Axe, Two-HandedTenet: Stand between the weak and those who'd prey on them. Advantage on saves against instant-death effects. Once/day: when reduced to 0 HP or below, instead remain at 1 HP.
NocticulaWhipTenet: Offer a second chance to anyone who truly seeks one. Advantage on saves vs charm and fear. Once/day, when a spell or weapon attack of yours damages one creature, you regain HP equal to half the damage dealt.
MaskSword, ShortTenet: Take what you can, without being seen. Advantage on Stealth and sleight of hand. Once/day, while in shadow: you are Invisible until the end of your next turn.

Deities of Other Peoples

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

DeityFavoured WeaponTenet and Granted Power
CorellonSword, LongTenet: Protect the elven people and their homeland. Advantage on saves vs charm and sleep. Once/day: teleport up to 60ft to a location you can see.
EilistraeeSword, BroadTenet: Help any drow who seeks a way out of the dark. Advantage on Perception. Once/day: end the Blinded condition, or magical darkness, in a 30ft radius.
LolthCat-O-Nine-TailsTenet: Climb by any means, and let none above you rest easy. Advantage on Stealth underground. Once/day: webs fill a 20ft radius within 60ft; each creature there makes a Reflex save or is Restrained for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.
MoradinHammer, WarTenet: Craft to last, and never cut corners. Advantage on Perception underground. Once/day: shape stone within 10ft into any simple form. While you stand on natural stone or earth, you can't be pushed or knocked Prone against your will.
GruumshSpearTenet: Conquer, and take what is yours. Advantage on Intimidation. Once/day: when you hit, deal +1d8 damage and the target makes a Will save or is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn.
MaglubiyetAxe, BattleTenet: Prove your strength through victory. Advantage on navigation and survival checks outdoors. Once/day: grant a creature a free move at full speed that provokes no Attack of Opportunity and ignores difficult terrain.
AnnamMace, LargeTenet: Honour the giants' order of standing. Advantage on checks to recall or find historical information. Once/day: perfectly recall any event you witnessed. Against a creature you fought in an earlier encounter, one spell of yours each round ignores its resistances.
BahamutGlaiveTenet: Defend the innocent, and vanquish evil where you find it. Choose acid, cold, fire or lightning at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it. Once/day: exhale a 15ft cone of that type (2d6, Reflex save for half). Advantage on saves against fear.
TiamatPick, HeavyTenet: Take what you can hold, and hoard what you take. Advantage on Intimidation. Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison at 1st level: you have Resistance 5 to it. Once/day: exhale a 15ft cone of that type (2d6, Reflex save for half).
Zindel of Mournas (Son of the Watcher)Sword, BastardTenet: No one is a slave: free those in chains. Advantage on saves against fear. Once/day: when an ally within 30ft is hit by an attack, you take the damage instead.
Daeric Khyrmin (The Phoenix Prince)Sword, LongTenet: Master the blade and the spell as one. Advantage on saves against charm. Once/day: for the encounter, while you wield a one-handed blade, the first attack against you each round has Disadvantage.

The Elemental Lords

DeityFavoured WeaponTenet and Granted Power
AkadiFlail, HeavyTenet: Travel freely, and never cage what should fly. Once per encounter, the first creature you hit, or that fails a save against your spell, is pushed 10ft and makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or falls Prone. During a storm or rain this works once per round instead. Once/day: call a lightning strike on a creature within 60ft (3d6, Reflex save for half).
GrumbarClubTenet: Stand firm, and keep your word as you'd keep a foundation. While you stand on natural stone or earth, you can't be pushed or knocked Prone against your will. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, the ground within 20ft of you becomes difficult terrain for your enemies until your next turn. 9th level: the ground reaches 40ft. Once per encounter, when you cast the spell, enemies in the ground also can't take the Disengage action until the start of your next turn.
IstishiaHammer, WarTenet: Adapt as water does, and never be still for long. Advantage on Swim checks, and you can hold your breath ten times as long. Once/day: a 15ft-radius surge of water within 60ft puts out non-magical fire and pushes each creature in it 10ft away (Fortitude save negates the push).
KossuthFlail, LightTenet: Make and unmake by fire. Advantage on saves vs cold. Once/day: create a 15ft cone of fire (2d6 damage, Reflex save for half).

Evil Deities

DeityFavoured WeaponTenet and Granted Power
AsmodeusSword, RapierTenet: Honour the letter of every contract, and twist its spirit to your gain. Advantage on Deception. Once/day: force a bargain to be honoured (Will save negates). A creature that knowingly breaks it has Disadvantage on all rolls for 24 hours. Once per round, a creature that fails a save against your spell is bound by your terms: it cannot attack you until your next turn.
BaneMorningstarTenet: Rule through fear, and crush rebellion. Once/day: every enemy within 15ft makes a Will save or is Frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns. Advantage on Intimidation.
BhaalDaggerTenet: Kill as a sacred act, and let no death be wasted. Once/day: next hit vs a creature below half HP deals maximum damage. Advantage on Perception checks against wounded or fleeing creatures.
CyricSword, ShortTenet: Sow lies, doubt and madness. Once/day: force belief in a lie for an hour (Will save negates). Advantage on Deception, and you can Feint as the Feint feat describes.
MyrkulScytheTenet: All things end, so hasten their ending. Advantage on death-threat Intimidation. Speak with Dead is always prepared for you, and once a day (twice from 9th) you cast it without a slot. When a creature dies within 30ft of you, gain temporary HP equal to its Level.
SharDaggerTenet: Keep your secrets, and steal others'. Advantage on Stealth in darkness. Once/day: snuff all nonmagical light within 30ft for 10 minutes. 9th level: the darkness is magical, and you see through it.
Shune the VileDaggerTenet: Hoard forbidden lore. Advantage on concealing true intent. Once/day: plant a false memory (Will save negates). Advantage on initiative.
AurilAxe, BattleTenet: Warmth and pity are weaknesses. Resistance 5 to cold damage. Once/day: a weapon attack deals +1d6 cold damage and halves the target's speed for 1 round.
Tharizdun (The Chained God)Improvised weaponTenet: Serve the old and patient thing. Advantage on unsettling-presence Intimidation. Once/day: one creature within 30ft makes a Will save or is Stunned for 1 round.
UmberleeTridentTenet: Pay the sea its tithe before every voyage. Advantage on Swim and water-based checks. Once/day: create a wave in a 30ft line, 5ft wide: creatures in it make a Fortitude save or are pushed 15ft and knocked Prone.

system.description: • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without Disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list. Your deity's favoured weapon also serves as your holy symbol.

• Effect: An option you may take.
    • If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
    • The choice is permanent.
    • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +12 at 20th) instead of the Cleric's, you are trained with every melee weapon, and you gain Extra Attack at 7th level.
    • Your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level, never lower than the 1st-level row, and you never gain slots above 7th level.
    • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.
• Effect: You have Advantage on saves against the abilities of undead (drains, paralysis, fear and possession). Always on.

rules.when: against the abilities of undead (drains, paralysis, fear, possession)

system.description: • Effect: Once per day, cast a spell you have already cast today without expending a slot: a 1st-level spell, or of 2nd level or lower from 9th level, and 4th or lower from 15th.

activities.text: Once per day, cast a spell you have already cast today without expending a slot: {1:a 1st-level spell, 9:one of 2nd level or lower, 15:one of 4th level or lower}.

system.description:
Size Medium • Speed 30ft • Darkvision 60ft • +2 Wis / +1 Cha, −1 Str

Traits

  • Resistance 5 to necrotic & radiant. At will: bright light 10ft radius (illumination only).
  • Celestial Wings (1st): wings of light let you glide. You take no damage from falls, and move 2ft sideways for every 1ft you drop. From 3rd level your wings carry you: you have a fly speed equal to your walking speed.
  • Ascension (5th): once per day, your fly speed doubles for the encounter (1 Luck for a second use).
  • Flight: you can't fly in medium or heavy armour or while over your carrying limit; from 9th level you can fly in any armour you are trained in (still not over your carrying limit). You fall if you are knocked Prone, Stunned, Paralysed or Unconscious in the air (see Falling Damage in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Advantage on saves vs frightened.
  • Choose one Wisdom or Charisma skill at creation; you have Advantage on checks with it. This is not a Proficiency tier and is not one of your 3 starting skills.

system.description:
Favoured weapon: Mace, Heavy

Granted power: Tenet: Greet every dawn as a fresh start, and give others the same second chance.

  • Once per round, when an undead takes a hit from you or fails a save against your spell, it takes +1d6 radiant damage and can't regain HP until the end of its next turn.
  • Once/day, when you use Turn Undead, dawn light fills its area: every enemy in it that is not undead also makes a Will save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

Allegiance: Neutral Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Lathander in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Range 30ft; one creature that understands your language.

  • It follows a one-word command on its next turn: Approach (moves towards you), Drop (releases held items), Flee (moves away at full speed), or Halt (does not move). Will negates.
  • Mindless creatures are immune.
  • Harmful commands are ignored.

Classes: Cleric, Paladin, Warlock

Range 60ft; a spectral weapon for 1 round per level.

  • Each round on your turn it strikes one creature within 5ft of it automatically, no roll: 1d6 + 1 per three levels force damage (maximum 1d6+4).
  • You move it up to 30ft per round.
  • AC 15, 10 HP; destroyed by dispel.

Classes: Cleric, Paladin
